name: website-magal
description: Jekyll site da marca Daniel Magalhães. npm scripts are thin wrappers over bundler.

scripts.serve: export PATH="$(ruby -e 'print Gem.user_dir')/bin:$PATH" && bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload
scripts.build: export PATH="$(ruby -e 'print Gem.user_dir')/bin:$PATH" && JEKYLL_ENV=production bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.clean: export PATH="$(ruby -e 'print Gem.user_dir')/bin:$PATH" && bundle exec jekyll clean
